[D1:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?
[D1:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?
[D1:3] Audrey: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!
[D1:4] Andrew: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?
[D1:5] Audrey: Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?
[D1:6] Andrew: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?
[D1:7] Audrey: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!
[D1:8] Andrew: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?
[D1:9] Audrey: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.
[D1:10] Andrew: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.
[D1:11] Audrey: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?
[D1:12] Andrew: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.
[D1:13] Audrey: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?
[D1:14] Andrew: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.
[D1:15] Audrey: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?
[D1:16] Andrew: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!
[D1:17] Audrey: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.
[D1:18] Andrew: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.
[D1:19] Audrey: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?
[D1:20] Andrew: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!
[D1:21] Audrey: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!
[D1:22] Andrew: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!
[D1:23] Audrey: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!
[D1:24] Andrew: Take care and have a good one! See ya!
[D2:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I got a surprise for you! We adopted another puppy called Pixie. She's SO cute! Isn't she just the cutest?
[D2:2] Andrew: That's awesome! Pixie is so cute! Did you ever check out that hiking spot we talked about last time?
[D2:3] Audrey: Thanks! I know right? She's so cute! Pixie's been keeping us busy, so I haven't had a chance to check out that hiking spot yet.
[D2:4] Andrew: Yeah, I get it. A puppy really takes some work. Has she settled in okay? Is she getting along with the other pups?
[D2:5] Audrey: Pixie's fitting in great! It took her a few days to get used to the other dogs, but now they're awesome friends. They love playing and exploring the house - so cute!
[D2:6] Andrew: That's awesome! Is Pepper adjusting well to her?
[D2:7] Audrey: Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together!
[D2:8] Andrew: That's great to hear! I'm considering getting a dog too, but it can be challenging finding a dog-friendly place in the city. Do you have any tips on finding such a place?
[D2:9] Audrey: We used websites that helped us find a place that allowed dogs. They had filters that made it super easy. Found a perfect spot thanks to them!
[D2:10] Andrew: Wow, that's so cool! I'll give those websites a try, thanks for the info!
[D2:11] Audrey: You got it! I hope you find a great spot soon!
[D2:12] Andrew: Thanks! Fingers crossed for the apartment and that furry friend.
[D2:13] Audrey: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you to find a great furry friend and an apartment.
[D2:14] Andrew: Hope I find one soon. Can't wait!
[D2:15] Audrey: You'll love them! They're great for cuddles and companionship.
[D2:16] Andrew: It'd be so great to have a furry buddy to cuddle and hang with. Here's a photo of my family's dog on a couch.
[D2:17] Audrey: Our furry friends make great cuddle buddies. Here's one of them enjoying some lazy couch time!
[D2:18] Andrew: That pic is so cute! It would be fun to hang out with a dog, cuddling away. Got me thinking of my old hiking pics and how much I miss exploring nature trails with my family's dog. Ah, the peaceful moments out in nature!
[D2:19] Audrey: Taking them on hikes must be awesome! That makes me want to hike with my dogs.
[D2:20] Andrew: Hiking with a dog is way fun, it's a great way to bond and create memories together.
[D2:21] Audrey: Yeah! Exploring nature with them and making memories is awesome!
[D2:22] Andrew: Definitely! I miss those moments. I need to find a dog-friendly spot soon so I can get exploring again!
[D2:23] Audrey: Yep! I hope you find the perfect dog-friendly spot soon so you can make new memories with them.
[D2:24] Andrew: Thanks! I'll keep looking until I find it. Super excited for what's next!
[D2:25] Audrey: So excited for you! I can't wait to see where you and your furry friend decide to hang out. All the best!
[D2:26] Andrew: I'll keep you posted. Ttyl, Bye!
[D3:1] Andrew: Hey Audrey! What's up? Missed chatting with ya! Check it out, my girl & I tried out that new cafe scene in the city last weekend! Super fun but kinda sad not being out in nature - that's when I feel like I'm really thriving. Oh man, I miss the peacefulness of being out on a hike.
[D3:2] Audrey: Hey Andrew! That cafe sounds pretty awesome, glad you enjoyed it. Yeah, I know what you mean. That feeling of being out in nature, surrounded by beauty and peace, is unbeatable, compared to being surrounded by concrete jungles.
[D3:3] Andrew: Yeah, being out in the nature really has a way of taking my breath away. It's like a home for my soul! I feel connected when I'm there.
[D3:4] Audrey: I totally get it. Nature has a way of bringing us back down to earth and reminding us that we're part of something bigger. It's amazing.
[D3:5] Andrew: Yeah, it's like hitting the reset button when life gets too chaotic. Nature has a way of being really soothing.
[D3:6] Audrey: Definitely! For me, taking my dogs for a walk in the park helps me find my center and recharges me.
[D3:7] Andrew: I hear ya. Can’t do that here unfortunately, city living makes it hard. Really miss that connection and companionship.
[D3:8] Audrey: Must be tough living in the city without the opportunity to go outside. Sure is a different experience.
[D3:9] Andrew: Yeah, it really does. Sometimes it feels like I'm missing out.
[D3:10] Audrey: It must be tough. City life can get overwhelming, so it's great to find ways to connect to nature. What kind of things do you like to do in the city?
[D3:11] Andrew: My girlfriend and I love to discover new places to eat around town. It's a great way to try something new and wind down after a long week.
[D3:12] Audrey: Wow, that sounds like a great way to explore the city! Trying new places and food is always fun. Have you discovered any new favorite spots recently?
[D3:13] Andrew: We found an awesome cafe with amazing pastries - the smell was just irresistible!
[D3:14] Audrey: Sounds amazing! Did you take a photo? I'd love to see!
[D3:15] Andrew: Yep, I got them! Check out this photo of the delicious pastries we had at the cafe.
[D3:16] Audrey: Wow, they look great! What did you get? Now I'm craving pastries!
[D3:17] Andrew: They taste great too! We had some delicious croissants, muffins, and tarts! It was amazing!
[D3:18] Audrey: Wow, sounds amazing! Glad you got to enjoy them. Since you metioned pastries, I made some of my favorite treats last week. Let's have a pastry party sometime!
[D3:19] Andrew: That looks delicious! A pastry party sounds awesome, count me in!
[D3:20] Audrey: Awesome! My dogs will tag along. My furry friends would love it!
[D3:21] Andrew: Definitely! They'll have a great time at the party! Can't wait for the party!
[D3:22] Audrey: Same! Looking forward to it. This would be a good chance for you to hang out with them.
[D3:23] Andrew: Yeah! It's gonna be awesome to see all of them together and chowing down. Super excited!
[D3:24] Audrey: Yay! This'll be awesome! Seeing them all together, having fun and enjoying treats is the best. I can't imagine life without them, they bring so much joy.
[D3:25] Andrew: Aww, so cute! I bet their happy faces means a lot to you.
[D3:26] Audrey: I know right? They mean the world to me. So much that I got tattoos of them on my arm.
[D3:27] Andrew: Wow, that tattoo looks great!
[D3:28] Audrey: Thanks! I got it a while ago. It represents my love for my pups and nature's beauty.
[D3:29] Andrew: Aww, that's cute! What made you getting the tattoo?
[D3:30] Audrey: I've always had a strong bond with them – they make me so happy, and I just want to see their happy faceseven when thry're not with me.
[D3:31] Andrew: That's awesome, I'm glad they bring so much joy into your life.
[D4:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird. It was so cool watching it dart around with its wings! Nature is so beautiful.
[D4:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Glad to hear from you. That hummingbird was awesome! Nature's the best. Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!
[D4:3] Audrey: That looks great! How often are you able to go hiking now?
[D4:4] Andrew: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!
[D4:5] Audrey: Nice! I Bet it's great to get away like that.
[D4:6] Andrew: Yep! Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.
[D4:7] Audrey: Wow, that view looks great! It really captures that calming and peaceful feeling. It must be really satisfying to capture that tranquility.
[D4:8] Andrew: Yeah! I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
[D4:9] Audrey: That's really cool! Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.
[D4:10] Andrew: I agree! It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace - it's like a ripple effect, spreading positivity.
[D4:11] Audrey: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
[D4:12] Andrew: Yeah, it's crazy how that can bring such great joy and calm to people.
[D4:13] Audrey: Yeah, by sharing something can make a big difference to others.
[D4:14] Andrew: Yup! We don't realize it, but even the littlest gestures can have a big effect. Spreading good vibes and joy, that's the goal right? So what's up? Anything new or fun going on?

turns.speaker: Caroline

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that's cool, Caroline! What happened that was so awesome? Did you hear any inspiring stories?

turns.text: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, love that painting! So cool you found such a helpful group. What's it done for you?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's really cool. You've got guts. What now?

turns.text: Gonna continue my edu and check out career options, which is pretty exciting!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! What kinda jobs are you thinkin' of? Anything that stands out?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm keen on counseling or working in mental health - I'd love to support those with similar issues.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: You'd be a great counselor! Your empathy and understanding will really help the people you work with. By the way, take a look at this.

turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! That's really sweet. Is this your own painting?

turns.speaker: Melanie

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Melanie! The colors really blend nicely. Painting looks like a great outlet for expressing yourself.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Painting's a fun way to express my feelings and get creative. It's a great way to relax after a long day.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Totally agree, Mel. Relaxing and expressing ourselves is key. Well, I'm off to go do some research.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yep, Caroline. Taking care of ourselves is vital. I'm off to go swimming with the kids. Talk to you soon!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline, since we last chatted, I've had a lot of things happening to me. I ran a charity race for mental health last Saturday – it was really rewarding. Really made me think about taking care of our minds.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That charity race sounds great, Mel! Making a difference & raising awareness for mental health is super rewarding - I'm really proud of you for taking part!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! The event was really thought-provoking. I'm starting to realize that self-care is really important. It's a journey for me, but when I look after myself, I'm able to better look after my family.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I totally agree, Melanie. Taking care of ourselves is so important - even if it's not always easy. Great that you're prioritizing self-care.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, it's tough. So I'm carving out some me-time each day - running, reading, or playing my violin - which refreshes me and helps me stay present for my fam!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's great, Mel! Taking time for yourself is so important. You're doing an awesome job looking after yourself and your family!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline. It's still a work in progress, but I'm doing my best. My kids are so excited about summer break! We're thinking about going camping next month. Any fun plans for the summer?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Researching adoption agencies — it's been a dream to have a family and give a loving home to kids who need it.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! That's awesome! Taking in kids in need - you're so kind. Your future family is gonna be so lucky to have you!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! My goal is to give kids a loving home. I'm truly grateful for all the support I've got from friends and mentors. Now the hard work starts to turn my dream into a reality. And here's one of the adoption agencies I'm looking into. It's a lot to take in, but I'm feeling hopeful and optimistic.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that agency looks great! What made you pick it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I chose them 'cause they help LGBTQ+ folks with adoption. Their inclusivity and support really spoke to me.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's great, Caroline! Loving the inclusivity and support. Anything you're excited for in the adoption process?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm thrilled to make a family for kids who need one. It'll be tough as a single parent, but I'm up for the challenge!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: You're doing something amazing! Creating a family for those kids is so lovely. You'll be an awesome mom! Good luck!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words really mean a lot. I'll do my best to make sure these kids have a safe and loving home.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: No doubts, Caroline. You have such a caring heart - they'll get all the love and stability they need! Excited for this new chapter!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Melanie! How's it going? I wanted to tell you about my school event last week. It was awesome! I talked about my transgender journey and encouraged students to get involved in the LGBTQ community. It was great to see their reactions. It made me reflect on how far I've come since I started transitioning three years ago.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! Great to hear from you. Sounds like your event was amazing! I'm so proud of you for spreading awareness and getting others involved in the LGBTQ community. You've come a long way since your transition - keep on inspiring people with your strength and courage!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Your backing really means a lot. I felt super powerful giving my talk. I shared my own journey, the struggles I had and how much I've developed since coming out. It was wonderful to see how the audience related to what I said and how it inspired them to be better allies. Conversations about gender identity and inclusion are so necessary and I'm thankful for being able to give a voice to the trans community.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, you're doing an awesome job of inspiring others with your journey. It's great to be part of it and see how you're positively affecting so many. Talking about inclusivity and acceptance is crucial, and you're so brave to speak up for the trans community. Keep up the great work!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks Mel! Your kind words mean a lot. Sharing our experiences isn't always easy, but I feel it's important to help promote understanding and acceptance. I've been blessed with loads of love and support throughout this journey, and I want to pass it on to others. By sharing our stories, we can build a strong, supportive community of hope.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, Caroline! It takes courage to talk about our own stories. But it's in these vulnerable moments that we bond and understand each other. We all have our different paths, but if we share them, we show people that they're not alone. Our stories can be so inspiring and encouraging to others who are facing the same challenges. Thank you for using your voice to create love, acceptance, and hope. You're doing amazing!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Your words mean a lot to me. I'm grateful for the chance to share my story and give others hope. We all have unique paths, and by working together we can build a more inclusive and understanding world. I'm going to keep using my voice to make a change and lift others up. And you're part of that!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline, for letting me join your journey. I'm so proud to be part of the difference you're making. Let's keep motivating and helping each other out as we journey through life. We can make a real impact together!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah Mel, let's spread love and understanding! Thanks for the support and encouragement. We can tackle life's challenges together! We got this!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yes, Caroline! We can do it. Your courage is inspiring. I want to be couragous for my family- they motivate me and give me love. What motivates you?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that photo is great! How long have you had such a great support system?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah, I'm really lucky to have them. They've been there through everything, I've known these friends for 4 years, since I moved from my home country. Their love and help have been so important especially after that tough breakup. I'm super thankful. Who supports you, Mel?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm lucky to have my husband and kids; they keep me motivated.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, what an amazing family pic! How long have you been married?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: 5 years already! Time flies- feels like just yesterday I put this dress on! Thanks, Caroline!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Congrats, Melanie! You both looked so great on your wedding day! Wishing you many happy years together!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Appreciate your kind words. Looking forward to more happy years. Our family and moments make it all worth it.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Looks like you had a great day! How was it? You all look so happy!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: It so fun! We played games, ate good food, and just hung out together. Family moments make life awesome.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sounds great, Mel! Glad you had a great time. Cherish the moments - they're the best!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Absolutely, Caroline! I cherish time with family. It's when I really feel alive and happy.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I 100% agree, Mel. Hanging with loved ones is amazing and brings so much happiness. Those moments really make me thankful. Family is everything.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Melanie! Long time no talk! A lot's been going on in my life! Take a look at this.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey, Caroline! Nice to hear from you! Love the necklace, any special meaning to it?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's gorgeous, Caroline! It's awesome what items can mean so much to us, right? Got any other objects that you treasure, like that necklace?

turns.text: That's awesome, Melanie! Family moments like that are so special. Glad y'all had such a great time.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Woah, Caroline, it sounds like you're doing some impressive work. It's inspiring to see your dedication to helping others. What motivated you to pursue counseling?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! You've gained so much from your own experience. Your passion and hard work to help others is awesome. Keep it up, you're making a big impact!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words mean a lot.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Congrats Caroline! Good on you for going after what you really care about.

[D10:9] Jon: Thanks! Your words mean a lot. Gotta focus on success and why I started. You're right, I love it and that'll keep my confidence up.
[D10:10] Gina: No worries, Jon! Sounds like what I said was helpful. You're incredibly talented and passionate about dance. Don't forget, believe in yourself and your abilities. Tackle any obstacle that comes your way and keep shining!
[D10:11] Jon: Thanks! Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and reach my dreams no matter what.
[D10:12] Gina: Go for it, Jon! You got this! Don't let anything stop you. We're in this together!
[D10:13] Jon: Appreciate your encouragement. We'll keep pushing each other on this path.
[D10:14] Gina: Yeah! Let's keep each other going. We can do it!
[D11:1] Jon: Hi! Since we last spoke I am still working on the dance studio and things are looking up!
[D11:2] Gina: Hi! You're so inspiring taking it on and opening your own studio!
[D11:3] Jon: Thanks! Losing my job gave me the push to finally start my dream business: my own dance studio! Now I'm stepping into the unknown and hoping for the best.
[D11:4] Gina: It must be scary stepping into the unknown but I know you can do it, Jon. With your determination and drive, your dance studio will be a huge success. Keep that positive outlook and keep going!
[D11:5] Jon: Thanks! It's a bit scary, but I just think about my love for dance and how it makes me feel. It's been my stress-buster since childhood!
[D11:6] Gina: Gotcha, Jon! Dance is my stress fix too. As soon as I start, all my worries vanish. It's amazing what we can do for our own mental health with something we enjoy.
[D11:7] Jon: Yeah, Gina! Dancing helps me de-stress. It's where I'm most alive. It's a must-have in my life.
[D11:8] Gina: I get it, Jon. Dance is just me -- I can't picture life without it. It's like air.
[D11:9] Jon: Yep! Dancing is like second nature to me. I'm living my dream by having my own dance studio and teaching others.
[D11:10] Gina: You're living the dream and inspiring others too! Your studio will totally change things for lots of folks.
[D11:11] Jon: I hope so, Gina. I want to create a place for people to dance and express themselves - it's been a dream of mine.
[D11:12] Gina: That's a great dream, Jon! Giving people a place to express themselves with dance is really important. Your studio is gonna make a huge difference. Can't wait to see it happen!
[D11:13] Jon: Thanks! Your help means a lot. Keep you posted on the dance studio progress.
[D11:14] Gina: Thanks! Really appreciate you keeping me in the loop on this cool project. Can't wait to hear more and watch it come to life! Oh, btw, I had an interview for a design internship yesterday! It was so cool.
[D11:15] Jon: Wow, Gina, I'm stoked about this! Taking a risk is scary, but I'm sure following my dreams will pay off in the end. How did the interview go?
[D11:16] Gina: It was great!
[D11:17] Jon: Glad to hear it. Been practicing dance routines lately, it keeps my mind focused and motivated.
[D11:18] Gina: Wow! That's great. Dancing is awesome for staying focused. Wanna show me a routine sometime?
[D11:19] Jon: Sure, Gina! Wanna see one of my routines? Lemme know when you got time and I'll send you a vid.
[D11:20] Gina: Yeah, Jon, I'll watch your routine! So proud of you!
[D11:21] Jon: Thanks a lot! Your help really means a lot. I'll get the video to you soon!
[D11:22] Gina: No prob! Always here to help. Can't wait to see the vid!
[D12:1] Gina: Hey Jon! Long time no talk! A lot's happened - I just got accepted for a fashion internship!
[D12:2] Jon: Congrats, Gina! That's awesome news about the fashion internship. 🎉 So stoked for you. Where is the internship and how're you feelin' about it?
[D12:3] Gina: Thanks! I'm excited and kinda nervous. Gonna be a big change. It's part-time position in the fashion department of an international company.
[D12:4] Jon: Way to go, Gina! You really stepped up. What's your plan for the future?
[D12:5] Gina: Thanks! I'm a mix of excited and scared to get into fashion, but I'm trying to stay upbeat and learn as much as I can. What about you? Got something new?
[D12:6] Jon: I'm currently reading "The Lean Startup" and hoping it'll give me tips for my biz.
[D12:7] Gina: It sounds great! Could it spark any ideas for your dance studio?
[D12:8] Jon: Yeah, the book got me thinking about building a focused and efficient business. Adapting and tweaking from customer feedback is important too, so I'm gonna try it out!
[D12:9] Gina: Woah, Jon, that whiteboard's got a bunch of good ideas! How you gonna keep track and stay on schedule with those dates?
[D12:10] Jon: Thanks, Gina! It helps me keep track of ideas and milestones. Gives me a visual of my progress and keeps me organized.
[D12:11] Gina: Nice idea! Having something visual can help with organizing and motivation. What're you working on currently?
[D12:12] Jon: I'm wrapping up the business plan and looking for investors. My passion for the project and belief in its success are driving me.
[D12:13] Gina: Wow, Jon! Impressed by your commitment. How's the hunt for investors going?
[D12:14] Jon: Thanks! Searching for investors has been tough, but I'm staying hopeful. It's all a process and I'm learning a ton.
[D12:15] Gina: Yeah Jon, you've got the right attitude! Keep learning and growing through it all. Keep going!
[D12:16] Jon: Thanks! I really appreciate your help. I'm gonna keep on going and never quit.
[D12:17] Gina: Keep it up!
[D12:18] Jon: Thanks! Your words really mean a lot. Don't worry, I won't let anything get me down.
[D12:19] Gina: Go Jon! Obstacles are inevitable, but you can do awesome things. Keep going!
[D13:1] Jon: Hey Gina, thanks for being there for me and believing in me. It means a lot.
[D13:2] Gina: Sure, Jon! I'm always around for you. How've you been since we caught up?
[D13:3] Jon: I'm prepping for my dance studio more than ever!
[D13:4] Gina: Proud of you for starting your own business! It takes strength to stay hopeful. What are you doing to prep for your dance studio? I have developed a video presentation to teach how to style my fashion pieces, btw.
[D13:5] Jon: Thanks, Gina! It's been so inspiring to work with our young dancers, seeing their passion and commitment. Opening the dance studio's been a great experience - I want it to be a place of support and encouragement for all our dancers. Will you show me this presentation?
[D13:6] Gina: Shure, I will send it to you later. Starting this studio isn't just a business, it's a place for dancers to grow. What support are you offering them?
[D13:7] Jon: Besides the dance classes and workshops, I'm offering one-on-one mentoring and training to help dancers reach their full potential.
[D13:8] Gina: Your one-on-one mentoring and training will really push dancers to reach their goals. I totally get it, I had a mentor too when I was learning how to dance.
[D13:9] Jon: Yeah, a mentor can do wonders. Guidance and support can help dancers really shine.
[D13:10] Gina: Nice one, Jon! How've you been using it?
[D13:11] Jon: I'm using it to stay organized and motivated. It sets goals, tracks my achievements and helps me find areas to improve.
[D13:12] Gina: Really cool system! Being organized sure is key for getting stuff done. How do you keep up with your goals and progress?
[D13:13] Jon: I also use whiteboard to stay on track, visualize goals and tokenize successes. It keeps me motivated and focused.
[D13:14] Gina: Cool! Are you using different colors?
[D13:15] Jon: Yes. I color-code achievements so I can easily track my progress and stay motivated.
[D13:16] Gina: Wow, color-coding is a great way to track your progress & stay motivated. Keep it up!
[D13:17] Jon: Thanks! It helps me stay motivated and reminds me why I'm doing this.
[D13:18] Gina: Yeah, its a great idea!
[D13:19] Jon: Thanks!
[D13:20] Gina: Remember that staying positive is very important. Rock on!
[D13:21] Jon: Thanks, Gina! Your support's really been awesome.
[D13:22] Gina: Thanks! Keep going for your dreams and don't quit!
[D13:23] Jon: I won't give up, Gina! I'll keep pushing and working to make my dreams happen. Thanks for the support!
[D14:1] Jon: Gina, you won't believe it - I got mentored by this amazing business dude yesterday! It was really inspiring and now I'm even more pumped to chase my dreams. What's been up with you lately?
[D14:2] Gina: Wow, Jon! Mentors can really help. I'm working on my online store, growing the customer base. It's tough but I'm determined. How about you? Any new things happening?
[D14:3] Jon: Been doing some promotion for my business. Crazy ride so far, but I'm hanging in there. Got any tips for marketing?
[D14:4] Gina: Awesome! Marketing is key. Use social media channels and work with influencers for bigger reach.
[D14:5] Jon: Thanks for the advice, Gina! I already started doing what you said about social media and posted some of my dance videos. It's creating a bit of a stir.
[D14:6] Gina: Nice! Glad your dance vids are doing well online. Keep it up!
[D14:7] Jon: Your help really helps. Hey, have you thought about being an entrepreneur?
[D14:8] Gina: Ha, yeah, Jon. I've been one 'cause I lost my job. I opened an online clothing store and it's been great! Being my own boss and doing something I love is awesome.
[D14:9] Jon: Wow, Gina! You did great taking that leap. Congrats! Got any advice for someone just starting out?
[D14:10] Gina: Thanks, Jon! It was a huge jump, but totally worth it. My advice: stay passionate, focused and resilient. Challenges will come, but believe in yourself and keep going. And stay open to learning and improving.

question: Select the one option that is still true after the conversation. Answer with one option letter only.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Haha, now that would be something! Sure, you should come down and join me on the trails sometime!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Joanna!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sure thing Nate! See you later!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: See ya!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! How've you been? Been a busy week since we talked.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Just finished something - pretty wild journey!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Way to go! I just got a new addition to the family, this is Max!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, he's adorable! How long have you had him? I can see why you're thrilled!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! It's awesome - he's adopted and so full of energy, and he's filling my life with so much joy. He's even keeping my other pets active.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Pets sure do make life better! Glad Max is bringing you lots of joy.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep, totally! Pets make us so much happier and never let us down. Have you thought any more of getting one of your own?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Unfortunately, allergies make it so I don't really want to get any, and I'm too lazy to research alternative pets for my allergies.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Aww, that's unfortunate. It's nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, though. How do you find comfort when you don't have any?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Writing and creative projects are what get me through tough times. I'm also grateful for my supportive friends.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! Those both can definitely be therapeutic. It's great to have such positive relationships that make such a great impact.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah. It's so nice to have friends who understand and appreciate my work - it's priceless being able to talk about it together and receive feedback. Here's a look at what I've been working on – it's been quite a journey, but I made it!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that looks great Joanna! Is that your third one?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yep! I chose to write about this because it's really personal. It's about loss, identity, and connection. It's a story I've had for ages but just got the guts to write it. It was hard, but I'm so proud of it.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That sounds impressive. You really do like writing about sadness and loss don't you.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Yeah I really do. I had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics. But I think meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings. It was scary, but I found that I write best when I'm being true to myself - even if it's hard.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Well done, Joanna! It takes guts to explore your experiences and feelings. I'm proud of you for staying strong and being true to yourself. Keep it up!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Your support really means a lot. Knowing I've got people like you cheering me on makes this journey way easier.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: No worries, Joanna! Keep going and reach for your dreams. You've got tons of talent and potential!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Jo! Been ages since we last talked. Here's something cool that happened the other day - I took Max for a walk and ran into this super nice couple who had a dog. It turns out they live close by. We decided to do doggy playdates, which is awesome considering we all need friends for our pets.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. Sounds like a nice encounter on your walk. Connecting with others who have pets can be uplifting and rewarding.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It's like fate. Having a walking buddy forMax will be great. He really likes the other dog too!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awesome! Did you get to know the couple very well? What were they like?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: They actually didn't share a whole lot in common with me besides the love of animals, but I think that was all we needed to share in common to be good friends!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's really cool that you can just go out and meet people like that, keep it up Nate!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! I just really enjoy watching our pets play with one another. Its like a dream come true seeing my dog so happy.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I can see why having a peaceful presence around could help relieve stress. Having someone or something to come home to for a sense of calm would be helpful for relaxation.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep, Joanna. It's great! Looky here, I got this new pup for you!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awww! It's so cute! I love the thought Nate!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! It's a stuffed animal to remind you of the good vibes.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's so sweet! I'll cherish that little guy with all my heart!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah! It's like having joy in your pocket. It always makes me grin when I look at it.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's great, Nate! Appreciate the small joys like that cute stuffed animal. It's a nice reminder!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Agreed, those little things sure do make life better!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I'll always remember those moments that bring us happiness and remind us that life is great!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sure, Joanna! It's all about finding those little things and cherishing them, otherwise it's easy to get down!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thinking back to the tough times finishing my screenplay made me realize it's those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, those little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times. Enjoying the ride is key.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Appreciating the journey and being aware of those happy moments can be a game-changer! It keeps us focused on our dreams. Can't wait to show it to you. I value your opinion!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Can't wait to see it, Joanna! I'm here to support you.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: No worries! You've got this. Keep it up!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Nate, after finishing my screenplay I got a rejection letter from a major company. It really bummed me out.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sorry to hear that, Joanna. Rejection stinks, but it doesn't mean you're not talented. Don't give up on your dreams!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate. It can feel like a step back sometimes. But I appreciate your kind words and encouragement.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sure, just make sure you keep going and believing in yourself. Did something happen with the company?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: They just sent me a generic rejection letter without much feedback. It's disheartening not knowing why it didn't work out.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Ugh, that's so frustrating. But don't get discouraged, just keep going.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah, you're right. I won't let this bring me down. Thanks for your support. What have you been up to lately?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I've been doing great - I just won another regional video game tournament last week! It was so cool, plus I met some new people. Connecting with fellow gamers is always awesome.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Way to go, Nate! Congratulations on your victory in the tournament! It must feel great to be recognized for your gaming skills.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! Winning was a huge confidence boost and shows my hard work paid off. I'm really happy with my progress.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I am as well! It's great to hear from you about your tournaments throughout the years!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! I has been a while since my first tournament hasn't it? I appreciate your support!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Anytime Nate! I'm here for you every step of the way.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I talked to some of the guys at the tournament afterwards, and they said they wanted to hang out later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds like fun! It's good to have friends that share your interests!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: For sure! They asked for some tips in how to improve their game, so I said I could help.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Good on you for helping strangers out! Stepping outside your comfort zone is always great.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, I just like helping people. Do you have any plans for the weekend?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yep, I'm hiking with some buddies this weekend. We're checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall. Can't wait! Do you have any fun plans?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds great! Have fun with that. I'm organizing a gaming party two weekends later - it'll be hectic but fun!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh? Are you going to invite your tournament friends?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Definitely! And some old friends and teamates from other tournaments.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds like fun, Nate! I wish you the best on your party. Have a blast!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! I'm sure it'll be a blast. I'm even getting everyone custom controller decorations just for coming!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, I bet they'll love that! What a sweet idea.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I know right? Have a great hike. Take lots of pics! See ya later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! See you later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Congrats, Joanna! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! It was a real roller coaster, but seeing the hard work pay off was amazing. Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's great, Joanna! Iron Man is my top pick. I love his tech and that sarcastic humor. Seeing these figures just makes me feel invincible!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, Nate! That's awesome. I love the tech and funny jokes of Iron Man too. What made you get that figure?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! I got it because it reminded me of something I love. Its presence in my room is a good reminder to keep working on my goals. Any inspiring things in your room?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: My cork board is full of inspiring quotes and pictures for motivation and creativity. It's my little corner of inspiration.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow Joanna, that sounds great! Could you show me a picture of it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Here ya go, a pic of my cork board. It's got quotes, photos, and little keepsakes.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's a great pic of your family! What made you hang it on your cork board?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Having that picture on my cork board reminds me of the love and encouragement from them every day.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's great, Joanna. Family support is invaluable. It's so good to have those reminders.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Absolutely, it means a lot and keeps me going.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I really should start a cork board of my own shouldn't I. That seems like a really valuable thing!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I would definitely recommend it! As long as your willing to explain what it is to your friends.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Of course! Well see you later Joanna!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Bye Nate!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate, long time no see! How have you been? I just got done submitting my recent screenplay to a film contest just to see how others might like it!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's really cool Joanna! I hope it does well, and I've been doing great! The gaming party was a great success! We even played some Chess afterward just for fun.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Nice! Did your friends like the controller accessories?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Most of them did! I can't say if all of them will continue to use them or not, but that's beside the point.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah Nate, you're right. It doesn't matter if they use it, its the thought that matters right?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Absolutely! There were 7 people that attended, and 6 of them said they'd want to do it again next month!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sure thing! I can give it to you tomorrow, how does that sound?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Nice one, Joanna! Hope you and your family like it. Let me know how it went!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?

turns.speaker: Joanna

[D11:15] Joanna: I think about my life too sometimes when I'm out and about, but there was something special about these trails that made me feel like writing a drama.
[D11:16] Nate: Hey, we should go together sometime, don't you think? Maybe I'll start to think of a drama myself and publish my own screenplay.
[D11:17] Joanna: Haha, now that would be something! Sure, you should come down and join me on the trails sometime!
[D11:18] Nate: Sounds like a plan! Thanks for the invite Joanna!
[D11:19] Joanna: Sure thing Nate! See you later!
[D11:20] Nate: See ya!
[D12:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! How've you been? Been a busy week since we talked.
[D12:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Just finished something - pretty wild journey!
[D12:3] Nate: Way to go! I just got a new addition to the family, this is Max!
[D12:4] Joanna: Wow, he's adorable! How long have you had him? I can see why you're thrilled!
[D12:5] Nate: Thanks! It's awesome - he's adopted and so full of energy, and he's filling my life with so much joy. He's even keeping my other pets active.
[D12:6] Joanna: Pets sure do make life better! Glad Max is bringing you lots of joy.
[D12:7] Nate: Yep, totally! Pets make us so much happier and never let us down. Have you thought any more of getting one of your own?
[D12:8] Joanna: Unfortunately, allergies make it so I don't really want to get any, and I'm too lazy to research alternative pets for my allergies.
[D12:9] Nate: Aww, that's unfortunate. It's nice seeing the joy pets bring to others, though. How do you find comfort when you don't have any?
[D12:10] Joanna: Writing and creative projects are what get me through tough times. I'm also grateful for my supportive friends.
[D12:11] Nate: Wow, that's awesome! Those both can definitely be therapeutic. It's great to have such positive relationships that make such a great impact.
[D12:12] Joanna: Yeah. It's so nice to have friends who understand and appreciate my work - it's priceless being able to talk about it together and receive feedback. Here's a look at what I've been working on – it's been quite a journey, but I made it!
[D12:13] Nate: Wow, that looks great Joanna! Is that your third one?
[D12:14] Joanna: Yep! I chose to write about this because it's really personal. It's about loss, identity, and connection. It's a story I've had for ages but just got the guts to write it. It was hard, but I'm so proud of it.
[D12:15] Nate: That sounds impressive. You really do like writing about sadness and loss don't you.
[D12:16] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Yeah I really do. I had to be vulnerable and dig deep into those topics. But I think meaningful stories come from personal experiences and feelings. It was scary, but I found that I write best when I'm being true to myself - even if it's hard.
[D12:17] Nate: Well done, Joanna! It takes guts to explore your experiences and feelings. I'm proud of you for staying strong and being true to yourself. Keep it up!
[D12:18] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your support really means a lot. Knowing I've got people like you cheering me on makes this journey way easier.
[D12:19] Nate: No worries, Joanna! Keep going and reach for your dreams. You've got tons of talent and potential!
[D13:1] Nate: Hey Jo! Been ages since we last talked. Here's something cool that happened the other day - I took Max for a walk and ran into this super nice couple who had a dog. It turns out they live close by. We decided to do doggy playdates, which is awesome considering we all need friends for our pets.
[D13:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Great to hear from you. Sounds like a nice encounter on your walk. Connecting with others who have pets can be uplifting and rewarding.
[D13:3] Nate: It's like fate. Having a walking buddy forMax will be great. He really likes the other dog too!
[D13:4] Joanna: Awesome! Did you get to know the couple very well? What were they like?
[D13:5] Nate: They actually didn't share a whole lot in common with me besides the love of animals, but I think that was all we needed to share in common to be good friends!
[D13:6] Joanna: That's really cool that you can just go out and meet people like that, keep it up Nate!
[D13:7] Nate: Thanks! I just really enjoy watching our pets play with one another. Its like a dream come true seeing my dog so happy.
[D13:8] Joanna: I can see why having a peaceful presence around could help relieve stress. Having someone or something to come home to for a sense of calm would be helpful for relaxation.
[D13:9] Nate: Yep, Joanna. It's great! Looky here, I got this new pup for you!
[D13:10] Joanna: Awww! It's so cute! I love the thought Nate!
[D13:11] Nate: Thanks! It's a stuffed animal to remind you of the good vibes.
[D13:12] Joanna: That's so sweet! I'll cherish that little guy with all my heart!
[D13:13] Nate: Yeah! It's like having joy in your pocket. It always makes me grin when I look at it.
[D13:14] Joanna: That's great, Nate! Appreciate the small joys like that cute stuffed animal. It's a nice reminder!
[D13:15] Nate: Agreed, those little things sure do make life better!
[D13:16] Joanna: I'll always remember those moments that bring us happiness and remind us that life is great!
[D13:17] Nate: Sure, Joanna! It's all about finding those little things and cherishing them, otherwise it's easy to get down!
[D13:18] Joanna: Thinking back to the tough times finishing my screenplay made me realize it's those moments that bring joy and make the journey worth it.
[D13:19] Nate: Yeah, those little moments make it all worth it, especially during tough times. Enjoying the ride is key.
[D13:20] Joanna: Appreciating the journey and being aware of those happy moments can be a game-changer! It keeps us focused on our dreams. Can't wait to show it to you. I value your opinion!
[D13:21] Nate: Can't wait to see it, Joanna! I'm here to support you.
[D13:22] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D13:23] Nate: No worries! You've got this. Keep it up!
[D14:1] Joanna: Nate, after finishing my screenplay I got a rejection letter from a major company. It really bummed me out.
[D14:2] Nate: Sorry to hear that, Joanna. Rejection stinks, but it doesn't mean you're not talented. Don't give up on your dreams!
[D14:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate. It can feel like a step back sometimes. But I appreciate your kind words and encouragement.
[D14:4] Nate: Sure, just make sure you keep going and believing in yourself. Did something happen with the company?
[D14:5] Joanna: They just sent me a generic rejection letter without much feedback. It's disheartening not knowing why it didn't work out.
[D14:6] Nate: Ugh, that's so frustrating. But don't get discouraged, just keep going.
[D14:7] Joanna: Yeah, you're right. I won't let this bring me down. Thanks for your support. What have you been up to lately?
[D14:8] Nate: I've been doing great - I just won another regional video game tournament last week! It was so cool, plus I met some new people. Connecting with fellow gamers is always awesome.
[D14:9] Joanna: Way to go, Nate! Congratulations on your victory in the tournament! It must feel great to be recognized for your gaming skills.
[D14:10] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Winning was a huge confidence boost and shows my hard work paid off. I'm really happy with my progress.
[D14:11] Joanna: I am as well! It's great to hear from you about your tournaments throughout the years!
[D14:12] Nate: Thanks! I has been a while since my first tournament hasn't it? I appreciate your support!
[D14:13] Joanna: Anytime Nate! I'm here for you every step of the way.
[D14:14] Nate: I talked to some of the guys at the tournament afterwards, and they said they wanted to hang out later!
[D14:15] Joanna: Sounds like fun! It's good to have friends that share your interests!
[D14:16] Nate: For sure! They asked for some tips in how to improve their game, so I said I could help.
[D14:17] Joanna: Good on you for helping strangers out! Stepping outside your comfort zone is always great.
[D14:18] Nate: Thanks, I just like helping people. Do you have any plans for the weekend?
[D14:19] Joanna: Yep, I'm hiking with some buddies this weekend. We're checking out a new trail with a rad waterfall. Can't wait! Do you have any fun plans?
[D14:20] Nate: Sounds great! Have fun with that. I'm organizing a gaming party two weekends later - it'll be hectic but fun!
[D14:21] Joanna: Oh? Are you going to invite your tournament friends?
[D14:22] Nate: Definitely! And some old friends and teamates from other tournaments.
[D14:23] Joanna: Sounds like fun, Nate! I wish you the best on your party. Have a blast!
[D14:24] Nate: Thanks Joanna! I'm sure it'll be a blast. I'm even getting everyone custom controller decorations just for coming!
[D14:25] Joanna: Wow, I bet they'll love that! What a sweet idea.
[D14:26] Nate: I know right? Have a great hike. Take lots of pics! See ya later!
[D14:27] Joanna: Thanks Nate! See you later!
[D15:1] Joanna: Hey Nate! Yesterday was crazy cool - I wrote a few bits for a screenplay that appeared on the big screen yesterday! It was nerve-wracking but so inspiring to see my words come alive!
[D15:2] Nate: Congrats, Joanna! Seeing your hard work pay off like that must've felt amazing. I bet it was scary too, but awesome! You're so inspiring. By the way, last time we saw eachother, I noticed a spiderman pin on your purse. Is Spider-Man your favorite superhero, or do you have another fave?
[D15:3] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It was a real roller coaster, but seeing the hard work pay off was amazing. Spider-Man has always been a favorite of mine - I mean, who doesn't love Peter Parker's struggles between being a hero and being a person? But I'm kind of a sucker for any superhero - everyone has their own rad story and powers. Do you have a favorite superhero?
[D15:4] Nate: That's great, Joanna! Iron Man is my top pick. I love his tech and that sarcastic humor. Seeing these figures just makes me feel invincible!
[D15:5] Joanna: Wow, Nate! That's awesome. I love the tech and funny jokes of Iron Man too. What made you get that figure?
[D15:6] Nate: Thanks Joanna! I got it because it reminded me of something I love. Its presence in my room is a good reminder to keep working on my goals. Any inspiring things in your room?
[D15:7] Joanna: My cork board is full of inspiring quotes and pictures for motivation and creativity. It's my little corner of inspiration.
[D15:8] Nate: Wow Joanna, that sounds great! Could you show me a picture of it?
[D15:9] Joanna: Here ya go, a pic of my cork board. It's got quotes, photos, and little keepsakes.
[D15:10] Nate: That's a great pic of your family! What made you hang it on your cork board?
[D15:11] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Having that picture on my cork board reminds me of the love and encouragement from them every day.
[D15:12] Nate: That's great, Joanna. Family support is invaluable. It's so good to have those reminders.
[D15:13] Joanna: Absolutely, it means a lot and keeps me going.
[D15:14] Nate: I really should start a cork board of my own shouldn't I. That seems like a really valuable thing!
[D15:15] Joanna: I would definitely recommend it! As long as your willing to explain what it is to your friends.
[D15:16] Nate: Of course! Well see you later Joanna!
[D15:17] Joanna: Bye Nate!
[D16:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! How have you been? I just got done submitting my recent screenplay to a film contest just to see how others might like it!
[D16:2] Nate: That's really cool Joanna! I hope it does well, and I've been doing great! The gaming party was a great success! We even played some Chess afterward just for fun.
[D16:3] Joanna: Nice! Did your friends like the controller accessories?
[D16:4] Nate: Most of them did! I can't say if all of them will continue to use them or not, but that's beside the point.
[D16:5] Joanna: Yeah Nate, you're right. It doesn't matter if they use it, its the thought that matters right?
[D16:6] Nate: Absolutely! There were 7 people that attended, and 6 of them said they'd want to do it again next month!
[D16:7] Joanna: That sounds like a huge success then! Congrats!
[D16:8] Nate: Thanks! On another note, I made vegan ice cream last Friday and shared it with some people in my vegan diet group. It was awesome!
[D16:9] Joanna: Mm, yum! Can you give me the recipe for that? It sounds like it'd be a good recipe!
[D16:10] Nate: Sure thing! I can give it to you tomorrow, how does that sound?
[D16:11] Joanna: Awesome! I'm going to make it for my family this weekend - can't wait!
[D16:12] Nate: Nice one, Joanna! Hope you and your family like it. Let me know how it went!
[D16:13] Joanna: Sure thing! They love it when I make them new things!
[D16:14] Nate: Then I have no doubt they'll love the icecream!
[D16:15] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your support is greatly appreciated. I'll make sure to keep you updated.
[D16:16] Nate: Can't wait to hear about it. Have a great day! Take care.
[D17:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, check this out! I won my fourth video game tournament on Friday! It was awesome competing and showing off my skills - and the victory was indescribable. I'm really proud that I can make money doing what I love. This one was online!
[D17:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! That's awesome! So proud of you. Your hard work really paid off - keep it up! BTW, I took a road trip for research for my next movie while you were winning. Much-needed break and a chance to explore new places and get inspired.
[D17:3] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?
[D17:4] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!
[D17:5] Nate: That place looks interesting! Did you find any cool books there?
[D17:6] Joanna: I stumbled upon this super cool book from the 1900s with stories and sketches - so awesome to read about the town and the people living there!
[D17:7] Nate: That sounds really interesting! Anyting specific stick out to you about it?
[D17:8] Joanna: Woodhaven has had an interesting past with lots of cool people. Seeing how much it changed sparked ideas for my next script.
[D17:9] Nate: Real-life stories are the best for inspiration. Can't wait to hear about your next one. Keep it up!
[D17:10] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I'm stoked about this new script. It's different from my previous work, but it has the potential to be something awesome! I'll be sure to keep you posted.
[D17:11] Nate: I'm sure it will do just as well as your last one! Keep on trying and believe in yourself!
[D17:12] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your encouragement really means a lot to me. You're the best for supporting me in my writing journey.
[D17:13] Nate: I'm always here for you! You've got so much talent, just keep going for it!
[D17:14] Joanna: I will! I actually started on a book recently since my movie did well!
[D17:15] Nate: Nice! I'm curious, what is it about?
[D17:16] Joanna: That page specifically has some dialogues exploring loss, redemption, and forgiveness. It's a deep and emotional story that I'm really excited about!
[D17:17] Nate: Wow, Joanna! It sounds awesome. I'm so excited to see how it all plays out!
[D17:18] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I'm so glad you're excited. I've never really tried publishing a book, but this might be the first!
[D17:19] Nate: Good luck on that! I'm sure people will recognise you as the same author of the movie you got published and love the book even more.
[D17:20] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Your belief in me means a lot. I'll keep doing my best. Thanks for the support!
[D17:21] Nate: No problem, Joanna. I'm here for you. Your hard work will pay off, I promise. Believe in yourself and your talent - you're incredible!
[D18:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no talk! I've been busy with writing projects and really going all out with it. It's been the best thing ever - a mix of highs and lows - and my journal's pretty much my rock. Writing's such a huge part of me now.
[D18:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! Great to hear it! It's amazing how much a certain activity can become a part of our lives. Keep it up, you're inspiring! Is writing your way to solace and creativity?
[D18:3] Joanna: Yeah, definitely. Writing has become like an escape and a way to express my feelings. It gives me a chance to put all my thoughts and feelings down and make something good out of it. Words just have a magical way of healing.
[D18:4] Nate: That's really cool, I like it! It's incredible how words can turn something sad into something special. I'm glad it worked for you. Anything cool happening recently?
[D18:5] Joanna: Yep. Last week, someone wrote me a letter after reading an online blog post I made about a hard moment in my life. Their words touched me; they said my story had brought them comfort. It was awesome to realize my words had that kind of power. It reminded me why I love writing.
[D18:6] Nate: Nice work, Joanna! That must feel sureal. Keep it up - you're changing lives!
[D18:7] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Really appreciate your kind words. It's knowing that my writing can make a difference that keeps me going, even on tough days. So glad to have this outlet to share my stories and hopefully have an impact. How about you? Anything new since we last talked?
[D18:8] Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your words mean a lot. Since we last spoke, I started teaching people how to make this. Sharing my love for dairy-free desserts has been fun and rewarding.
[D18:9] Joanna: Yum, Nate! I love it when you make coconut milk icecream, it's so good!
[D18:10] Nate: I've been really into making this lately - it's creamy, rich, dairy-free and a new recipe! Wanna try it? I can share the recipe with you if you'd like!
[D18:11] Joanna: I'd love to try it! Thanks for sharing your love for dairy-free desserts. I really appreciate it!
[D18:12] Nate: No problem, Joanna! Always happy to share them with you. Sending you the recipe now!
[D18:13] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Can't wait to surprise my family with something delicious!
[D18:14] Nate: No problem, Joanna! Wish them luck! Let me know how it goes. Have a blast baking!
[D18:15] Joanna: Thanks, Nate. I'll keep you posted. Have a great day.
[D18:16] Nate: You too!
[D19:1] Nate: Woah Joanna, I won an international tournament yesterday! It was wild. Gaming has brought me so much success and now I'm able to make a living at something I'm passionate about - I'm loving it.
[D19:2] Joanna: Congrats, Nate! So proud of you for winning that tournament, that's awesome! Must feel great to turn your passion into a career.
[D19:3] Nate: I'm really stoked to see all my hard work paying off! I'm super proud of what I accomplished. On another note, my little dudes got a new tank! Check them out, they're so cute, right?!
[D19:4] Joanna: Wow Nate, they're adorable! I can see why you enjoy spending time with them. It looks like they have so much more room to swim now!
[D19:5] Nate: They're my little buddies, always calm and peaceful. It makes coming home after a long day of gaming better. The tank expansion has made them so happy! How have you been?
[D19:6] Joanna: I'm good! Was super nervous last week when I shared my book with my writers group but got some great feedback. My hard work is paying off, it's such an awesome feeling!
[D19:7] Nate: Wow Jo, you're killing it! Getting this kind of feedback means people are really connecting with your writing. Pretty cool! Did you celebrate?
[D19:8] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It feels great knowing that people like my writing. I celebrated by making this delicious treat - yum! Any plans for the weekend?
[D19:9] Nate: I'm taking some time off this weekend to chill with my pets. Anything cool happening with you?
[D19:10] Joanna: I'm relaxing and recharging this weekend with a long walk and some reading. It's a good break.
[D19:11] Nate: Looks like we both need a break. I'm glad your able to find a way to recharge! It's so incredibly important to take time off!
[D19:12] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I've learned that taking breaks and looking after myself are important for my inspiration and mental health. It's all about finding balance.
[D19:13] Nate: Yeah, balance is key! It's so cool how taking care of ourselves helps us be more creative and happier. I'm always looking for something new to read. Got any book recommendations? I've got a lot of books to choose from.
[D19:14] Joanna: I reccomend finding a fantasy book series to read through. Most fiction series are great reads when your trying to relax.
[D19:15] Nate: Good idea! How about this series?
[D19:16] Joanna: That's a great one! Let me know what you think when your finished!
[D19:17] Nate: Sure thing! And since your recommending me a book, I thought I should do the same! I'd really recommend this series. It's got awesome battles and interesting characters.
[D19:18] Joanna: Wow, that series looks awesome! I'll have to check it out sometime!
[D19:19] Nate: You really should! The action scenes are awesome and the plot rocks. Definitely one of my favorites!
[D19:20] Joanna: Wow, sounds great! I'll definitely add it to my list; thanks for the recommendation!
[D19:21] Nate: Enjoy it! Have a good day.
[D19:22] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! You too! Have a great day. Take care.
[D20:1] Nate: Hey Joanna! Long time no talk. So much has happened. Look how cute they are! Hanging with them has been a big help, especially recently. turns.speaker: Gina

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: That's cool, Jon! What got you into this biz?

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Wow Jon, same here! Dance is pretty much my go-to for stress relief. Got any fave styles?

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Yeah, me too! Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Yeah! Let's explore some new dance moves. We should plan a dance session soon!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Yeah definitely! Wanna see my moves next Fri? Can't wait!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Sounds great, Jon! Next Friday works. Let's boogie!

turns.speaker: Jon
turns.text: Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great!

turns.speaker: Gina
turns.text: Wow! What did you get?

turns.speaker: Jon

[D1:1] Gina: Hey Jon! Good to see you. What's up? Anything new?
[D1:2] Jon: Hey Gina! Good to see you too. Lost my job as a banker yesterday, so I'm gonna take a shot at starting my own business.
[D1:3] Gina: Sorry about your job Jon, but starting your own business sounds awesome! Unfortunately, I also lost my job at Door Dash this month. What business are you thinking of?
[D1:4] Jon: Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.
[D1:5] Gina: That's cool, Jon! What got you into this biz?
[D1:6] Jon: I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.
[D1:7] Gina: Wow Jon, same here! Dance is pretty much my go-to for stress relief. Got any fave styles?
[D1:8] Jon: Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?
[D1:9] Gina: Yeah, me too! Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.
[D1:10] Jon: Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!
[D1:11] Gina: Yeah! Let's explore some new dance moves. We should plan a dance session soon!
[D1:12] Jon: Yeah definitely! Wanna see my moves next Fri? Can't wait!
[D1:13] Gina: Sounds great, Jon! Next Friday works. Let's boogie!
[D1:14] Jon: Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great!
[D1:15] Gina: Wow! What did you get?
[D1:16] Jon: Woah, that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year. It was amazing up on that stage! I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps. Gina, you ever been in any dance comps or shows?
[D1:17] Gina: I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen. It was an awesome feeling of accomplishment!
[D1:18] Jon: Wow! Winning first place is amazing! What dance were you doing?
[D1:19] Gina: Thanks! We just did a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." It was really emotional and powerful.
[D1:20] Jon: Wow, that must've been great! Check my ideal dance studio by the water.
[D1:21] Gina: Cool setup! Man, you can't deny that view! Got time to rehearse with a biz and a new store?
[D1:22] Jon: Hopefully, we will find a place like this that will inspire us!
[D1:23] Gina: Wow, it looks great! What dances do you practice? Got any projects planned?
[D1:24] Jon: Thanks! I rehearsed with a small group of dancers after work. We do all kinds of dances, from contemporary to hip-hop. We've got some cool projects in the works. Finishing up choreography to perform at a nearby festival next month. Can't wait!
[D1:25] Gina: Wow, it looks awesome! Are they yours at the festival? They're so graceful!
[D1:26] Jon: Yeah, they're the ones performing at the festival! They've been practicing hard and will definitely impress with their grace and skill.
[D1:27] Gina: Wow, they look great! Can't wait to see them rock the festival. Gonna be awesome!
[D1:28] Jon: Yeah, awesome! Glad to be part of it.
[D2:1] Gina: Hey Jon! Long time no see! Things have been hectic lately. I just launched an ad campaign for my clothing store in hopes of growing the business. Starting my own store and taking risks is both scary and rewarding. I'm excited to see where it takes me!
[D2:2] Jon: Hey Gina! Whoa, your store looks great! All your hard work really paid off - congrats! Must be awesome to see your stuff on display.
[D2:3] Gina: Thanks a bunch! It's awesome seeing my vision happen. How's the dance studio going? Did you find the right spot?
[D2:4] Jon: Hey Gina! Thanks for asking. I'm on the hunt for the ideal spot for my dance studio and it's been quite a journey! I've been looking at different places and picturing how the space would look. I even found a place with great natural light! Oh, I've been to Paris yesterday! It was sooo cool.
[D2:5] Gina: Wow, nice spot! Where is it? Got any other features you want to think about before you decide? Paris?! That is really great Jon! Never had a chance to visit it. Been only to Rome once.
[D2:6] Jon: It's downtown which is awesome cuz it's easy to get to. Plus the natural light! Gotta check the size & floor quality too. We need a good dance floor with enough bounce for me & my students to dance safely.
[D2:7] Gina: Definitely! Dance floors help avoid injuries and make dancing more enjoyable. You thinking about it is great. Any particular type of flooring you like?
[D2:8] Jon: Yeah, good flooring's crucial. I'm after Marley flooring, which is what dance studios usually use. It's great 'cause it's grippy but still lets you move, plus it's tough and easy to keep clean.
[D2:9] Gina: Sounds great! Marley's perfect; it's got the right amount of grip and movement. Can't wait to see your dance studio done!
[D2:10] Jon: Yeah, can't wait to see it done! Looking for the right place and getting everything ready has been a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but I'm determined to make it work. It'll be worth it!
[D2:11] Gina: Believe in yourself, Jon! The process may be tough, but you got this. Push through and it'll be worth it. Don't forget to take breaks and dance it out when you need to destress!
[D2:12] Jon: Glad I have you in my corner! Gotta make time to dance and vent, that's for sure. We'll make it through this - hang in there!
[D2:13] Gina: Thanks, Jon! Appreciate your support!
[D2:14] Jon: Let's keep going and chase our dreams!
[D2:15] Gina: Yeah! We've done so much, and there's nothing but good stuff coming. Let's keep going after our goals and making them happen.
[D2:16] Jon: Success is almost here. We got this!
[D3:1] Jon: Hey Gina, hope you're doing ok! Still following my passion for dance. It's been bumpy, but I'm determined to make it work. I'm still searching for a place to open my dance studio.
[D3:2] Gina: Hi Jon! So happy you're pushing forward with dancing! Inspiring 💪 I emailed some wholesalers and one replied and said yes today! I'm over the moon because now I can expand my clothing store and get closer to my customers. Check it out - here's a pic!
[D3:3] Jon: Wow, Gina! You found the perfect spot for your store. Way to go, hard work's paying off!
[D3:4] Gina: Thanks! Glad you like it. Yeah, it's a great spot. Here's a peek at the space I designed. Cozy and inviting - perfect for customers to check out all the trendy pieces.
[D3:5] Jon: Wow, it looks great! Must've taken you ages to design it. What made you pick out the furniture and decor?
[D3:6] Gina: Thanks! It took a bit of time but I wanted to make the place look like my own style and make my customers feel cozy. I chose furniture that looks great and is comfy too. The chandelier adds a nice glam feel while matching the style of the store.
[D3:7] Jon: Your store looks great - your customers will be so comfy.
[D3:8] Gina: Thanks! Making my spot comfortable and inviting for my customers is key. I want 'em to feel like they're in a cool oasis. Just creating an experience that'll make 'em wanna come back.
[D3:9] Jon: That's a great goal! Creating a special experience for customers is the key to making them feel welcome and coming back. I think you can create that space you're imagining.
[D3:10] Gina: Thanks. Your support means a lot. I'm sure with my hard work and effort, I can make a special shopping experience for my customers. It's tough but I'm up for the challenge!
[D3:11] Jon: I'm always here to support you! Go create something awesome with your store. Keep it up!
[D3:12] Gina: Thanks, Jon! I'll try my best. You're gonna do great with your dance studio, just keep going and stay positive! We'll get through this!
[D3:13] Jon: Thanks! Your words mean a lot. I'm staying positive and pushing forward. We've put our hearts into our dreams and I'm sure we'll make it.
[D3:14] Gina: Sure thing, Jon! Stay motivated and keep going. Hard work pays off eventually. We can do this!

[D4:2] Gina: Hey Jon! The store's doing great! It's a wild ride. How's the biz?
[D4:3] Jon: Hey Gina! I'm putting in a lot of work on my business even with the obstacles. I'm gonna make it happen!
